name: Emotion 98.3
summary: A soft rock station that returns from Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, found in the released game by GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead.
body: Rockstar did not announce this station before launch; it is reported by outlets playing the released game.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: The Cars - Drive; Cliff Richard - Devil Woman; Phil Collins - In the Air Tonight; Roxette - Listen to Your Heart; Captain & Tennille - But I Think It's a Dream; Scritti Politti - Overnite; Carly Simon - Coming Around Again; Elton John - I Guess That's Why They Call It the Blues; Phil Collins - Against All Odds; Stevie Nicks ft. Tom Petty - Stop Draggin' My Heart Around; Dr. Hook - When You're In Love With A Beautiful Woman; Chris Rea - Fool (If You Think It's Over).
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

name: Vice City FM
summary: A station of 1980s pop and new wave, confirmed in the released game by GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead.
body: GameSpot notes the station had been seen on a real-world advert before launch. Rockstar's own pre-launch pages did not list it.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Stevie Nicks - Wild Heart; Echo & The Bunnymen - Lips Like Sugar; Curiosity Killed the Cat - Name and Number; Feargal Sharkey - A Good Heart; New Order - Thieves Like Us; Bryan Ferry - Kiss and Tell; Billy Ocean - Loverboy; Johnny Hates Jazz - Shattered Dreams; Jermaine Stewart - We Don't Have To Take Our Clothes Off; Culture Club - Miss Me Blind.
No host is named by any of the three outlets.
Kotaku reports that one of its hosts is "Weird Al" Yankovic, and says its writer confirmed this with Rockstar.

name: Stockyard FM
summary: An indie and dance station in the released game, listed by GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead.
body: Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Justice & Tame Impala - One Night / All Night; Neil Frances - You Move Me; Fischerspooner - Emerge; Roisin Murphy - Overpowered; Tommy Richman - Million Dollar Baby; CMD/CTRL - No Stress; ANOTR - Paradise; Rampa & WhoMadeWho - Abu Simbel.
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

name: VCRR
summary: The modern rap station in the released game, listed by GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead.
body: Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: BunnaB - Go Go Go; Drake - Nokia; Gunna - Count Up; Pooh Shiesty - Got Dat; Offset - I Just Came To Pop It; Denzel Curry - Fla Flow; Migos ft. Lil Uzi Vert - Bad and Boujee; Young Nudy - Don Da Da; French Montana & Swae Lee - Unforgettable; Cardi B - Don't Chart; Playboi Carti - Ahh Yea; Kodak Black & Don Toliver - Let's Rock; Travis Scott - RHYNO; Yung Lean ft. Future & Metro Boomin - That's It; Tee Grizzley - IKYFL.
Several of these are tracks from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album. GameSpot's list for this station is longer than the fifteen given here.
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

name: Honey FM
summary: An R&B and soul station in the released game, listed by GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead.
body: GameSpot and CULTR describe it as 1990s R&B and soul.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: D'Angelo - Lady; Sounds of Blackness - Optimistic; Zhané - Hey Mr. DJ; Montell Jordan - Get It On Tonite; T-Pain - Buy U a Drank; Color Me Badd - I Adore Mi Amor; Jagged Edge - Where the Party At; Akon ft. Styles P - Locked Up; Usher - Bad Girl; Next - Too Close; Tony! Toni! Toné! - Feels Good; 112 - Dance With Me; Groove Theory - Tell Me.
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

name: Radio La Ola
summary: A classic Latin station in the released game, described by GameSpot as the golden-age counterpart to Cocoteo FM.
body: Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Cachao - Descarga Cubana; El Gran Combo de Puerto Rico - No Hay Cama Pa' Tanta Gente; Celia Cruz ft. Johnny Pacheco - Besito de Coco; Gloria Estefan - Mi Tierra; Banda Blanca - Sopa de Caracol; Orquesta Harlow - La Cartera; Willy Chirino - Soy Guajiro; Charlie Palmieri - La Hija de Lola; Willie Colon & Ruben Blades - Ligia Elena; Roberto Torres - Caballo Viejo; Willie Colon & Ruben Blades - Pedro Navaja.
No host is named by GameSpot, CULTR or The Big Lead.

name: Radio On-U
summary: A reggae and dub station in the released game, which GameSpot says is named after Adrian Sherwood's On-U Sound label.
body: The outlets describe it differently: The Big Lead calls it reggae, CULTR reggae, dub and lovers rock, while GameSpot says it mostly plays fairly relaxed rock with some exceptions.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Adrian Sherwood - Dub Inspector; Louisa Mark - Caught You in a Lie; Horace Andy - Skylarking; Carroll Thompson - I'm So Sorry; Freddie McGregor - Big Ship; Ken Boothe - Everything I Own.
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

name: V-Rock
summary: The rock station from Grand Theft Auto: Vice City returns in the released game, now leaning to classic rock rather than heavy metal.
body: GameSpot says it keeps its vulture logo. Metal has moved to The Chamber 106.6.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Bon Jovi - Runaway; The Rolling Stones - Emotional Rescue; Huey Lewis & The News - I Want A New Drug; Lindsey Buckingham - Go Insane; Van Halen - Panama; Poison - Nothin' But A Good Time; Eric Clapton - Cocaine; Harry Nilsson - Jump Into the Fire; The Who - Bargain; Eddie Money - Take Me Home Tonight; John Mellencamp - Jack and Diane; Motley Crue - Dr. Feelgood; Pete Townshend - Let My Love Open the Door; Loverboy - Lovin' Every Minute of It; KISS - Sure Know Something.
No host is named by GameSpot, CULTR or The Big Lead.

name: Gloriana Blues Radio
summary: A blues station in the released game, listed by GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead.
body: Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Ella Fitzgerald - Trouble in Mind; Memphis Minnie - Me and My Chauffeur; Jimmy Rogers - That's All Right; John Lee Hooker - Boogie Chillen; Sister Rosetta Tharpe - Didn't It Rain; Koko Taylor - I Got What It Takes; Earl Hooker - Blue Guitar; Freddie King - Yonder Wall.
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

name: Leonida Jazz Radio
summary: A jazz fusion station in the released game, listed by GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead.
body: Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Return to Forever - Sorceress; Casiopea - Time Limit; Bob James - Night Crawlers; Stanley Clarke - School Days; Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes and Robert Glasper - Overtown Lights.
Overtown Lights is the closing track of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

name: Symphony FM
summary: The classical station in the released game, listed by GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead.
body: Works GameSpot reports hearing on it: Handel - Messiah; Liszt - Les Préludes; Lutosławski - Concerto for Orchestra; Prokofiev - Piano Concerto No. 2; Sibelius - Symphony No. 5 (third movement); Mahler - Symphony No. 6 (Allegro energico); Debussy - Nocturnes (Fêtes).
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

name: Worldwide FM
summary: Worldwide FM returns from Grand Theft Auto V and GTA Online in the released game, according to GameSpot.
body: GameSpot describes it as world music and jazz; CULTR and The Big Lead describe it as global club music.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Facta ft. Warrior Queen and Killa P - Slope VIP; Dongurizu - Yoppa Ratta; Fejão ft. Samtheman - Brasil de Capoeira; Cloud One - Atmosphere Strut; Jamiroquai - Smile; Garfield Fleming - Don't Send Me Away; Roberta Flack - The First Time Ever I Saw Your Face; Atmos Blaq - Skhaftin Saka Fonque; 4hero - Star Chasers.
No host is named by any of the three outlets.

facts.genre: World music, jazz and global club

name: CircoLoco Records Radio
summary: A club music station in the released game, named after the label Rockstar co-founded with the Ibiza party CircoLoco in 2021.
body: Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Skream - Floral; Michael Bibi - Rhythm of the Night; Mind Against - Let It Go.
GameSpot and CULTR list this station. The Big Lead's table does not include it.
No host is named.

name: Kaleidoscope FM
summary: A station of foreign-language covers and global pop oddities in the released game, hosted by the actor Jeremy Irons.
body: Rockstar's vice president of music, Ivan Pavlovich, told GameSpot the idea came from studio co-founder Sam Houser's love of foreign-language covers of his favourite songs, and that tracing rights holders was hard in some countries.
Pavlovich said Jeremy Irons plays a well-travelled host who tells tall tales of his adventures, and recorded the part in one session.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Rolf Bergstrom - Rokkibaby; Trevor M. Simpson & Hi Lo Singers - Stupid Girl; Phuong Thanh - Chia Tay Trong Mua; Marianne Rosenberg - Herz Aus Glas; Ron - Hai Capito O No?; Alim Qasimov & Farghana Qasimova - Say It Right.
GameSpot's managing editor also mentions a South Asian cover of Careless Whisper, without naming the performer.

name: WKTT
summary: A conservative talk station, short for We Know The Truth, that returns from Grand Theft Auto IV in the released game.
body: GameSpot says its logo has a bald eagle and a flag and that it carries the series' call-in satire.
GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead all list it as a talk station. None of them names a host or a show.

name: The Wipe
summary: A talk station in the released game about the absurd side of life in Leonida.
body: GameSpot says it offers trivia about Leonida, including odd goings-on a player may not have come across yet. CULTR calls it podcast-style talk.
GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead all list it. None of them names a host.

name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album track list
summary: Apple Music's listing for the official soundtrack album names all 34 tracks, opening with Justice and Michael McDonald and closing with Stanley Clarke.
body: The 34 tracks in order, as Apple Music lists them: 1. Justice - Starting From Zero (feat. Michael McDonald); 2. Yung Lean - That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin); 3. Playboi Carti - AHH YEA; 4. Travis Scott - RHYNO; 5. CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., Etienne de Crécy - Sexy Magic; 6. Justice, SZA, King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, Tame Impala - Flower In A Hurricane; 7. Dua Lipa - Go Easy; 8. Morgan Wallen - Last Thing You Need; 9. JHAYCO - X; 10. Fuerza Regida - Suzuki; 11. Rauw Alejandro - Macacoa 2000; 12. A Boogie wit da Hoodie - Dance With Me (feat. elkan); 13. Burna Boy - Bigger; 14. Gunna - COUNT UP; 15. Kodak Black, Don Toliver - Let's Rock; 16. Young Thug - WAKIN UP FLEX; 17. Tee Grizzley - IKYFL; 18. Don Toliver - TF?; 19. Cardi B - Don't Chart; 20. JT - GMA; 21. JENNIE - Power Trip; 22. Tove Lo - Blood In Your Eyes; 23. Zara Larsson - Fast Emotion; 24. Camila Cabello - Sweet Like Candy; 25. Fcukers - Only One; 26. Arca - Sandunguea; 27. Rina Sawayama - TRDWFE; 28. Rose Gray - All Again; 29. Lana Del Rey - Crazy For You; 30. Kali Uchis, Helado Negro - Largate; 31. Omar Apollo - NO ME BUSQUES; 32. Keith Richards - Bright Lights, Big City; 33. Jesse Johnson, DāM FunK - Stone Kold Krazy Luuv; 34. Stanley Clarke, Robert Glasper, Yussef Dayes - Overtown Lights.
Apple Music credits the recording to Atlantic Recording Corporation and Take-Two Interactive Software.
Apple Music's New Zealand store dates the album November 20, 2026 and still marked it as a pre-release when read. Rockstar's music page says it is coming November 19.
Rockstar itself has only named the ten singles on its music page; it has not published the full list on its own site.
